page.overview:
Who is George Joestar II?

He is the son of Jonathan Joestar and the late father of Joseph Joestar. He is also featured in the JORGE JOESTAR light novel as one of its main protagonists.

George resembles his father Jonathan and his son Joseph. He is only seen wearing a military . His hair is supposedly short and black.

Assumed to be a capable fighter pilot, George was one of the first to fly an aircraft during World War I. It's hinted that he may have had a talent for the Ripple much like his father and son, though he was never given any training to properly use it.

In the novel, George becomes a trained soldier at the Royal Air Force, being a skilled marksman. He flies a plane named the Star Shooter with his co-pilot Jim Graham.
